description: Existing biotech pipelines start with a target and hope for the desired clinical outcome. That might work for some indications, but not the brain. Psychiatric and neurological symptoms appear as changes in cognition,…
long_description: Existing biotech pipelines start with a target and hope for the desired clinical outcome. That might work for some indications, but not the brain. Psychiatric and neurological symptoms appear as changes in cognition, mood, and behavior. Clinical efficacy relies on regulating the neural control circuits behind them. When models can’t output cognition, mood, and behavior, they can’t evaluate the success of CNS interventions. That’s why 73% of drugs fail in Phase II, where efficacy is first measured. At Neuroblox we’ve spent the last 4 years building a platform that changes this paradigm: a multiscale, mechanistic neural circuit simulation engine that elicits cognition, mood and behavior, allowing scientists and clinicians to test brain interventions in silico. Neuroblox provides the ability to design neurotherapeutic interventions intentionally, with an outcomes-first approach. Load your model, simulate as many interventions as needed, compare and refine, and select the approach that works best. Thrilled to announce that our beta version is live. If you’d like to learn more or see a demo, feel free to message me directly, or reach out to info@neuroblox.ai https://www.neuroblox.ai/

Neurophos’ offerings include prototype OPUs and development systems designed to integrate into data center environments, and its platform targets engineering teams and compute-intensive applications that demand scalable AI inference capability. The business collaborates with industry partners and investors to advance its optical compute architecture and develop supporting software stacks and hardware modules for deployment. Neurophos also engages in pilot programs and partnerships to test its photonic processors in real-world compute environments and explore integration pathways with existing infrastructure. Its work leverages research in metamaterials and compute-in-memory design to reduce power consumption and enhance throughput for AI inference tasks.

long_description: Nous Research is a decentralized AI startup that focuses on developing open-source, human-centric artificial intelligence models and tools. Its work encompasses large language model architecture, data synthesis, fine-tuning, and reasoning, aiming to align AI systems with real-world user experiences. In addition to model development, the organization emphasizes decentralized AI training. It utilizes blockchain technology, specifically the Solana network, to coordinate and incentivize global participation in training its AI models.
